notes: Structural / dry-run validation: each prompt scopes the agent to materialize the runbook and stop at the Pre-flight gate, so we assert on runbook SHAPE without a full live execution (which would make real commits/PRs). Assertions check the generated .claude/runbooks/<slug>.runbook.md and the agent's stated plan.

evals.name: explicit-real-prd
evals.prompt: Take .claude/prds/save-claude-state.prd.md all the way to a PR — plan and build every milestone. First produce the runbook and stop at the Pre-flight gate so I can look before it executes.
evals.expected_output: Materialized runbook at .claude/runbooks/save-claude-state.runbook.md with Pre-flight first, a plan step per pending milestone from the Status column, tdd-vs-general implementation branch, single commit+PR consolidation, two review passes (2nd isolated) fixing non-LOW, stop=all-complete-and-clean, isolation assessment logged. Execution halts at the Pre-flight gate.
assertions: Pre-flight is the first phase and lists only human-only chores (or explicitly none)
one plan step per pending milestone, driven by the PRD Status column
implementation uses the tdd binding if the harness declares one, else falls back to /ecc:tdd-workflow, for code plans vs general agent for non-code

review and TDD tools are resolved from explicit harness bindings (chore-keyed, e.g. CLAUDE.md/.claude/rules/.claude/run-prd.bindings.*) rather than guessed or keyword-matched from repo/user config; each chore falls back independently only if unbound
single commit + one PR consolidation phase (not per-plan PRs)
no --review given, so default fast mode = one pass via the review.fast binding if declared, else the ecc:code-reviewer agent fallback, fixing all non-LOW
stop condition = all milestones complete AND both review passes clean of non-LOW
isolation assessment uses the isolation binding if the harness declares one, else the skill's own inner rubric, and logs which was used per plan/implementation call
execution stops at the Pre-flight gate as requested (does not commit or open a PR)

evals.name: implicit-latest-prd
evals.prompt: the prd's done, now just implement the whole thing end to end for me. show me the runbook first before you start running it.
evals.expected_output: Skill resolves the PRD by finding the most recently modified .prd.md under .claude/prds/ and confirms it, then produces the same runbook shape as eval 1, stopping before execution.
assertions: resolves the target PRD as the most recently modified .prd.md under .claude/prds/ and confirms it
runbook written under .claude/runbooks/ for the resolved PRD slug
Pre-flight first; milestone loop keyed on the Status column
single commit+PR consolidation and two review passes (2nd isolated)
does not begin execution before showing the runbook

evals.name: precondition-guard-no-milestones
evals.expected_output: The PRD has no `## Delivery Milestones` table, so the skill stops and points the user to /ecc:plan-prd instead of fabricating a backlog. No runbook, plans, commits, or PR are produced.
assertions: detects the missing Delivery Milestones table and stops
points the user to /ecc:plan-prd (there is no backlog to walk)
does not fabricate milestones, write a runbook, or create any plans/commits/PR
